description: This file contains React components and utility functions for authentication, using the Clerk React SDK. It includes environment variable access, route guards, sign-in/sign-up page components, and auth controls.

methods.name: getClerkPublishableKey
methods.description: Retrieves the Clerk publishable key from environment variables, logging a warning if not set.

methods.name: RouterAwareClerkProvider
methods.description: Wraps children components with ClerkProvider, passing the publishable key and route URLs.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute
methods.description: A route guard that displays children if user is signed in, else prompts to sign in.

methods.name: SignInPage
methods.description: Component rendering the sign-in page with Clerk's SignIn component.

methods.name: SignUpPage
methods.description: Component rendering the sign-up page with Clerk's SignUp component.

methods.name: AuthControls
methods.description: Component showing sign-in link when signed out, and user button with avatar when signed in.
